chapters: Jano' ba' na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii ka't jix duñia' kia'mi'ñ gu tanoolh jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook na ba' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Abisag gu Sunamita aichdhak gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu gɨ'kora'; gu' gu gɨ'kora' cham pai' dhuuk.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Adoniia gu mar gu aggit jix búup bham; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix duu gu ja'tkam kavaayo mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu taat cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu tanoolh bɨɨx a'ga; gio ba' gu ñi'ook a'ga gio ka't jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr dua'ñ mi' dhɨr gu Absalom.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia bɨɨx gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Adoniia.
Gu' gu' gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Semei gu Reii bɨx gu Dabii cham oi'ñchu' gu Adoniia.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Adoniia kakneer gu vaakax ju'ñdharan jodai kavɨk gu Soelet mia'n suudai' buusñi gu Rogel bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Judaa tu duukam gu gɨ'kora'.
Gu' gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' gu Benaiia tu' gu Salomoon xibhɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Nataan gu Bat-seba gu naan gu Salomoon bham; gio ba' cham naak gu ñi'ook gu Adoniia gu mar gu aggit cham maachim gu Dabii chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu oidha' gu mar gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' tu' ba'k gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios bham; mi' dhɨr gu Salomoon gu mar gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr tu' atooxkor gu ñi'ook gu Adoniia.
Jano' ba' kua' tu' gu ñi'ook a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' tu' ba'k bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Bat-seba chɨbiapui gu gɨ'kora' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu Abisag gu Sunamita gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Bat-seba gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr gu Salomoon gu mar gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr tu' atooxkor.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu Adoniia gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' jano' cham.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax mumua'da' kakneer tu' amuub bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Joab ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gu' gu Salomoon tu duukam cham tu' amuub.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel bhaan tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook chɨkka tu' atooxkor gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' mi' dhɨr.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx tattat tu' gu mar gu Salomoon duduaka'.
Jano' ba' kua' gu ñi'ook a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan suudai' u'va.

Jano' ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr na ja'p chɨbiapui gu gɨ'kora' o'lhia'n vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu vupui gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Nataan; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Adoniia gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr tu' atooxkor.

Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax mumua'da' kakneer tu' amuub bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gio gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' jugi i'i vupui bhaan jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu tai gu gɨ'kora' gu Adoniia.
Gu' gu' tu' tu duukam tu' gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada tu' gu Salomoon tu duukam tu' amuub.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' cham jix daa jix duñia' tu duukam chɨkka ka't atooxkor gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' mi' dhɨr.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii; gio ba' mɨmɨim gu Bat-seba; mi' dhɨr chɨbiapui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ bɨx.
Na na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu mar gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr tu' atooxkor pai'; na gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Bat-seba gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu vupui gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tai gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii; gio ba' mɨmɨim gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada; mi' dhɨr baap gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Jawatan gu Salomoon gu mar gu Gioon.

Jano' ba' tu jiim gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' kuichdha' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk bham; mi' dhɨr gu tai gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨlhdham atooxkor gu ñi'ook tu'; na gu' jix duñia' na ba' ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu Israeel bhaan gu Judaa.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Ameen; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' ka't bɨɨx gu Salomoon; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' atooxkor gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada gu Kereteos gu Peleteos tu' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhɨɨk gu Gioon.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨ'ñdhatu' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan tu jiim gu Salomoon; gio ba' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk jix aa' bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu tai gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu oidha' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' bɨɨx tu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk jix kai gu Adoniia bɨx koi'cham bɨɨx mi'p na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jugi; gio ba' tɨiñ gu Joab gu ñi'ook kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam kiicham bɨɨx.

Ba' jix aa' kua' gu ñi'ook a'gi'ñchu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jonataan gu mar gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan suudai' u'va gu Adoniia; na gu' ba'k na gu' tu' gu chio'ñ jix bhai' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan gu Adoniia; gio ba' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada gio gu Kereteos gu Peleteos jix duu gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' Xoi'kam gu Gioon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx kiicham gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu jodai' na jix uam jix duñia' naak.
Jano' ba' gio gu Salomoon tu' daakat atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' tɨbiap jix bhai' aa' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Salomoon gu tɨɨgɨ' jix gɨ' atooxkor; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' jix maa gu ñi'ook atooxkor gu vupui.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' jix búup bɨx koi'cham mi'p bɨɨx gu Adoniia ka't maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt.
Gu' gu' gu Adoniia gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon jix búup ka't jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook maachim gu Salomoon bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Adoniia juraa'n ɨɨbhi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon; na gu' tu' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bham; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon cham tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Salomoon; gio ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' maa'n kuupa'n gu oidha'; gu' tu' bakia' cham bhai' koi.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon aichdhak jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' suudai' u'va tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon; mi' dhɨr gu Salomoon jix aa'; jano' ba' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu Dabii na ba' koi jix aa'ñdhix gu Salomoon gu mar bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix nukadham jir bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios jiim gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees na ba' tu ñi'ook bɨx mii' dhɨr tu'.

Ba' jix aa' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam gu bhóogɨt jiim vupui bhaan tu' bɨɨx tu'r bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ mɨɨjidha' tu ñi'ook tu' gu chio'ñ atooxkor gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu tu' ñɨidhat tu' gu ñi'ook gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel gu Abner gu mar gu Ner gu Amasa gu mar gu Jeter mu'aa bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr bhɨɨ'ñdham jix dhaas gu ɨ'ɨr bhɨɨ'ñdham ga'ra' bhaan gu ñi'ook ga'ra' tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duu jurtu'nka' matda'; gio ba' cham kiicha' jix dhaav gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Barsillai gu Galaadita jix duu xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch ka't koi'cham gu vaak na jix bhai'; na pai' dhuuk na gu' tɨɨtɨs tu' na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Absalom xibhɨk.

Ba' jix aa' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak gu Semei gu mar gu Gera gu mar gu Benjamiin gu Baurim bɨɨx mu'ai jix kavɨk gu tanoolh tu' gu Maanaim; gu' jix dhaav gu Jordaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr tu' cham tu' kooda'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jano' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x ñɨidhat gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr jix duu jix dhaav bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix koox bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' kiicham gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh jix gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhaan gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu oo'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' kɨɨv jix gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu ñi'ook vaik jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu Salomoon atooxkor gu Dabii gu taat ka't oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Adoniia gu mar gu aggit suudai' u'va gu Bat-seba gu naan gu Salomoon; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr namkia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ jix aa'; jano' ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook no'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' ñɨidhat oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Israeel ka't gu ñi'ook tu' gu vupui na ba' tu'; gu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't bhaan suudai' u'va xibhɨk; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't.
Jano' ba' jano' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu vupui; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; na gu' tu' soi'ñ tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon na gu' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vupui na ba' jix maa gu Abisag gu Sunamita gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Bat-seba; gio ba' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Bat-seba gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon na ba' ñiokda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Adoniia; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix búup tu jiim tu' jix duñia' atooxkor tu' jix duu jix dhaas gu naan gu gɨ'kora' jix daa kɨɨ'n.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook gu vupui; jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu naan tu' cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Abisag gu Sunamita gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ xibhɨk gu Adoniia.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu naan; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Abisag gu Sunamita na ba' gu Adoniia gu Demanda gio na ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na gu' xibhɨk jix gɨ'; mi' dhɨr juraa'n gio gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu oidha' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Adoniia dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu jiim tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan atooxkor gu Dabii gu taat tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook gu Adoniia koi gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada jix maa bhaan jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Anatot dɨppɨr tu' suuska'n koi'm; na gu' gu' cham tu' kooda' gu ñi'ook na gu' baabuk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu Dabii gu taat jix duñia' bɨx tu'x ka't gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' kuugalh gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook bhaan gu vaak gu Eli gu Silo.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu Joab; na gu' gio gu Joab ka't jix bhai'x gu Adoniia tu' xoi'kam cham ka't jix bhai'x gu Absalom; mi' dhɨr gu Joab vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook maachim gu Salomoon gu Joab ka't jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' jano' ba' bhañ gu Salomoon gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada bham; mi' dhɨr gu Be jix maa bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui gu Benaiia vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook koi; gio ba' gu Benaiia bɨɨx dhi' gu gɨ'kora' bham; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook gu Joab jix aa'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu vupui na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu vaak gu taat gu ɨ'ɨr gu Joab tu' vaak na jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan mo'o; na tu' jix koi gook gu chio'ñ jir bhai' ja'tkam tutkɨ mu'aa cham gu taat gu Dabii cham tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Abner gu mar gu Ner ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel gu Amasa gu mar gu Jeter ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' gu ɨ'ɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan mo'o gu Joab bhaan mo'o gu kai' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gu' bhaan gu Dabii bhaan gu kai' bhaan gu vaak bhaan atooxkor bhai'x i'ii'ñ baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada jix tɨ'ɨ jix maa bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' gu vaak oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas pai' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Sadok jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan pai' gu Abiatar.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr bhañ gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Semei; gio ba' gu vaak gu Jerusalem jix duñia' cham baasɨ'n tu'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨda' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook bhi'ñbak gu Kedroon cham jix duñia' koi gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan mo'o.

Ba' jix aa' gu Semei gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam; jano' ba' jix daa gu Semei gu Jerusalem mui'x gu tanoolh.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik ka't jiboi'ññor gu Semei gook tu duukam gu Akîs gu mar gu Maakâ gu gɨ'kora' gu Gat; gio ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Semei bham; mi' dhɨr tu duukam gu Gat.
Jano' ba' jix búup jano' ba' gu Semei gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't gu Gat gu Akîs tu duukam; gio ba' ka't gu Semei tu duukam gu Gat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Salomoon na ja'p gu Semei ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem bɨɨx ka'm gu Gat ka't.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhañ tu' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Semei; gio ba' cham tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' bham; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bhai'x tɨɨda' koi tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Semei; gio ba' tu' ñɨidhat bɨx cham bhai' gu i'ii'ñ xoi'kam bhaan gu taat gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' cham bhai' bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam atooxkor gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'ñdhix gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada jix buus tu' naaka'n; gio ba' jix koi; mi' dhɨr oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't tu jiim gu novɨ gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto na gu' jix bhɨɨ mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon kiicham gu Dabii tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios vaak jodai gu Jerusalem xikoolh.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' cham ka't gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm mii' dhɨr ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jiim ñi'ook kavɨk gu taat gu Dabii; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai'.

Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Gabaoon na gu' ka't jix bhai'x gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' jix bhai'x maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Salomoon bhaan mii' dhɨr jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix ñi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon gu Gabaoon gu tukaa' tɨɨtki' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' tu' jix maa.

Ba' jix aa' gu Salomoon; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu duukam gu Dabii gu taat bhaan jix jiim vupui bhaan tu' tu'r bɨx bhai' bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ na ba' bɨndak; mi' dhɨr tu' dhi' jix gɨ' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch chɨɨdak gu mar atooxkor na ja'p dhi' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook tu' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' jix ali' cham tu' gu ñi'ook baakɨi tu' jix buus.
Jano' ba' tu duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' cham jɨ'xdha' gu ñi'ook tu'.

Jano' ba' jix maa tu duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam na ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' cham bhai'; na gu' chɨkka gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' dhi' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Adonai gu Salomoon dhi'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu ñi'ook dhi' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu' mui'x gu tanoolh tu' na ba' tu' namkɨm tu' gu oidha' obhɨɨ'ñ gu' na ba' tu' na ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jix maa gu i'ii'ñ jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n cham ka't va'k tu' na ja'p tu' mi' dhɨr tu' jix búup na ja'p tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio tu' jix maa tu'x cham namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' ka't na ja'p tu' bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt nukadham ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix jiim gu Dabii gu taat tu' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook jix ñi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' jix duu; mi' dhɨr jix duu gio bɨx tu duukam.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨtɨs gook gu u'vɨ gu gɨ'kora' vupui bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhi' gu u'vɨ gu vaak tu' kua' bɨɨx gu vaak.
Jano' ba' ka't vaik gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mai' ka't gu vaak gu ñi'ook gook gu vaak.
Na gu' gu tukaa' gu mar dhi' gu u'vɨ jix koi na gu' jix duñia' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix búup ɨraab gu tukaa' jix bhɨɨ gu mar ju'ñdharan tu' kua' tu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios kookos jix dhaas gu ñi'ook jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu mar jix koi.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh na ba' baaso gu mar ka't jix koi; gu' gu xibh tu' cham ka't gu mar tu' ka't.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr gu mar jix duñia' gu mar jix koi; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr gu mar jix koi gu mar jix duñia'; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' jano' ba'; gio ba' dhi' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu mar jix duñia' gu mar jix koi; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook cham gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi gu mar jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr aichdhak gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ ka't gu mar gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' na gu' ba'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook cham; gu' jix aa'; jano' ba' tu'; gio ba'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu ñi'ook cham; mi' dhɨr gu naan.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel jix kai mii' dhɨr ñi'ook na jir bhai' ka't jix maa gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't matda' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu chiñia' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Asariias gu mar gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu Eliorep gu Aiia gu ma'nkam gu Sisa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Ailud.
Jano' ba' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada ka't bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu Asariia gu mar gu Nataan ka't bhaan gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'; gio ba' gu Sabud gu mar gu Nataan ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Aisar ka't gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ; gio ba' gu Adoniram gu mar gu Abda ka't bhaan namki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak; gio ba' maa'n ka't oi'ñga'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu mar gu ur gu kavɨk gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Dekar gu Makkas gu Saalbim gu Bet-semes gu Eloon gu Bet-anan.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu esed gu Arubot; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ga'ra' gio gu Sokô bɨx gu oidha' gu Epet.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Abinadab bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dor; gio ba' ga'ra' gu u'vɨ gu Tapat mar u'vɨ gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' gu Baana gu mar gu Ailud gu Taanak gu Megiddo bɨx gu Bet-san mia'n gu Saretaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jesreel dɨr gu Bet-san bɨɨx ka'm gu Abel-meola bɨɨx ka'm baasɨ'n gu Jokmeam.

Jano' ba' gu mar gu Geber gu Ramot gu Galaad; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ga'ra' gio jɨ'dɨlh gu Jair gu mar gu Manasees mi'p gu Galaad; mi' dhɨr ga'ra' gio oidha' gɨ' gu Argob ka't gu Basaan gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx vaak jodai jix vɨgɨ jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Ainadab gu mar gu Iddo gu Maanaim.
Jano' ba' gu Aimaas gu Neptalii; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ gio gu u'vɨ gu Basemat mar u'vɨ gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu Baana gu mar gu usai gu Aser gu Alot.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Parua gu Issakâr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu Ela gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' gu Geber gu mar gu Uri gu oidha' gu Galaad gu oidha' gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' mii' dhɨr pai'.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa tu' gu Israeel jix duñia' mui'x na ja'p oo' ju'ñdharan gu gɨ' suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo' i'i.
Jano' ba' gu Salomoon aapi' bhaan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gɨ' suudai' jiim gu oidha' gu Pilisteos bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' i'i gu Salomoon bɨx gu tanoolh jix pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon ka't gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gu vaakax gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaakax kakneer; gio ba' cham chiiw gu u'uvhig.

Na gu' na gu' aapi' bɨx gu ñi'ook ka't baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim dɨr gu Tipsa bɨɨx ka'm gu Gasa bhaan bɨx gu gɨ'kora' baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim; gio ba' jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa tu' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook maa'n bɨtaa'n iigɨx dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba bɨx gu tanoolh gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu Salomoon oo'm mambhɨɨx gɨ' jix duñia' kavaayo na ba' mambhɨɨx gɨ'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bɨx meesa gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon aajidha' maa'n; gio ba' cham tu' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio i'i kai' vaas na ba' jix duñia' na ba' gu vaakax gu ñi'ook pai' ka't maa'n jurtu'nka' ga'ra'.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon matda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p oo' jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Na ka't jix gɨ' matda' gu Salomoon bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx matda' gu Egipkios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix maat bɨx gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' gu Etaan gu Esraita gu Emaan gu Kalkôl gu Darda gu ma'nkam gu Maol; mi' dhɨr ka't jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam xikoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' ua'rgidhat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu mambhɨɨx gɨ' jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'u dɨr gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu Liibano bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu vaakax gu u'uvhig gu ko'oi gu vatop.
Jano' ba' aajidha' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam matda' gu Salomoon bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' pai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n matda'.
Jano' ba' gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro bhañ gio tu duukam gu Salomoon jix kai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam Xoi'kam gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu taat; na gu' gu iram ka't bɨɨx tas dha' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Salomoon bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu iram.
Jano' ba' tu' ñɨidhat na ja'p gu taat gu Dabii cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu vaas tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx; na tu' cham tu'x jai'ch tu' cham bhai'.

Ba' jix aa' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh na jix bhai' jano' gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu taat bham; gio ba' gu mar tu' pai' atooxkor gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu Liibano; gio ba' tu duukam no'm bɨɨx tu' tu duukam tu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' ñɨidhat xoi'kam cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch gu u'u na ja'p gu Sidonios.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu iram jix kai gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu mar jix maat gu Dabii bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu iram gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon; gio ba' naak; mi' dhɨr tu' bɨx tu' gu ñi'ook gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu u'u ka't.

Jano' ba' tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu Liibano gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' tu' gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx ka'm pai' tu' nɨi'ñchudat tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duu aagak jugi ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu iram gu Salomoon gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu u'u ka't bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu iram gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' tiriik na ba' ja'tkam vaak gu ñi'ook bɨ'ñdhatu' na jix bhai'; gio ba' dhi' gu Salomoon gu iram oidha' tas.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon matda' na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu iram gu Salomoon tu' jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namki'ñdha' bɨx gu Israeel namki'ñdha' ka't gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Liibano mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' bai'ñpu' gu Liibano gook masaa'n gu vaak; gio ba' gu Adoniram ka't bhaan mii' dhɨr namki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gio gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gɨ' jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon mi'p bhaan tu duukam vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' vaik ko'kmarak gu ja'tkam jix duñia' tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai u'uuk na ba' gu vaak gu jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon gu iram gu u'u tɨ'ya' na ba' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' ka't oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Israeel moor gu Ejipto maakobh oi'ñga' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bhaan gu Israeel gu Sip gook kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu vaak gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu vaak ka't mambhɨɨx vupui bhaan gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio ju'ñdharan vaak jodai gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh bhaan gu vaak vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim xikoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jixchamaam tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik kɨɨv; na gu' mai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu vaak na ba' cham gu vaak.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu vaak na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai tu' gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak tu' jix kavɨk jodai.
Jano' ba' ki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook gu vaak; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas gu vaak bɨɨx gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu vaak gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu vaak bɨɨx gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon bham.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu vaak tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk tu' nukadham bɨx gu ñi'ook jiim tu' gu ñi'ook bɨndak gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Na ba' gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu u'u gu ñi'ook dɨr gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas gio bɨɨx gu u'u ka't.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu ñi'ook gɨ' u'u kavɨk dɨr bɨɨx ka'm jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu vaak pai'.
Jano' ba' gu vaak maachim vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu ñi'ook ga'ra' oo'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu vaak ka't iiñat gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ga'ra'; gio ba' bɨx ka't gɨ' u'u kavɨk; mi' dhɨr matgɨm gu jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak na ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't baasɨ'n ga'ra' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix uam jodai; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan dhaas jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon jix uam jodai na jix bhai' gu vaak gu ñi'ook ba'k bɨɨx jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai bɨx gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix uam jodai bɨx jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu u'u maa'n gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ga'ra' jixchamaam gu ñi'ook jixchamaam; na ba' ka't mambhɨɨx dɨr bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ga'ra' mambhɨɨx; na gu' jix duñia' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook maa'n ka't mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaak; gio ba' jix duñia' maa'n gu ñi'ook gook gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu vaak xikoolh ɇɇka' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook mai'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu ñi'ook mai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu ba'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiki'ñgob gu u'u; gio ba' jix duñia' jixchamaam.

Jano' ba' gook kiki'ñgob jix duñia' gu u'u gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan dhaas gio jix uam jodai gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu u'u.
Gu' gu' gook kiki'ñgob jix duñia' gu u'u ka't; gio ba' gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob jix duñia' gook ki'ñgob gio.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x vaik gu jodai gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' maakobh oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sip gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga' gu Bul jix bhai'x ka't gu ñi'ook gu vaak bɨɨx bɨx bɨɨx bɨx bɨɨpɨ'm; gio ba' pai'x kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak jix bɨɨx duu bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Liibano ga'ra' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan maakobh gɨ' u'u kavɨk bɨɨx gɨ' u'u kavɨk bhaan.
Jano' ba' ka't iiñat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ' u'u kavɨk jiix bhaan oo'm jixchamaam; gio ba' tu jiim ga'ra'.
Jano' ba' ka't vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan vaik.
Jano' ba' bɨx kiki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook mi'p jix bhai'x vaik.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ga'ra' jix duñia' mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't vupui bhaan mii' dhɨr bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duu.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam atooxkor ka't gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ñi'ook nɨidhim dhi'; gio ba' pai'x gio gu Salomoon gu vaak na ba' mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon ka't jix duñia' gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr buimɨi jix bɨɨx duu gu jodai u'uuk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bhaan gu ñi'ook na ja'p mai' dɨr bɨɨx ka'm mai' bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu jodai u'uuk gu jodai mambhɨɨx gu jodai.
Jano' ba' jiix jix duñia' gio gu jodai u'uuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' tu duukam gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh ka't vaik gu jodai gɨ' u'u kavɨk; gio ba' jix bhai'x gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tiro gu iram.

Jano' ba' gu mar ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam bopxi'ñ gu Neptalii gu taat ka't jix duñia' gu Tiro; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix vɨgɨ jodai jix bhuup matda' maachim bɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam; mi' dhɨr dhi' suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon tu' jix duu bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook jix vɨgɨ jodai gu ñi'ook ka't mambhɨɨx; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai jix vɨgɨ jodai na ba' bhaai'n bhaan ɨɨbhidham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix vɨgɨ na ba' bhaan ɨɨbhidham; gio ba' kɨɨv na ba'.
Jano' ba' jix duu na pai' dhuuk ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gook xikoolh gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a na ba' gu ñi'ook mi'p ɨɨbhidham bɨɨx; gio ba' duñia' jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi'p bhaan gu ñi'ook ko'kmarak gu ñi'ook maakobh.
Jano' ba' ko'kmarak gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gook xikoolh tu jiim vook ka't vupui bhaan gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan; na pai' dhuuk ka't gu ñi'ook gu novɨ tu jiim jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jakîn; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu novɨ o'nsop jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Boas.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas ɨɨbhidham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook duñia'; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't jixchamaam xikoolh gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu gɨ' suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨtaa'n gu ñi'ook na ja'p mambhɨɨx novɨ maa'nkar gu gɨ' suudai' xikoolh gook jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk ka't.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vaakax; gio ba' vaik gu ñi'ook vaik saagi'ñ vaik tas buusñi; mi' dhɨr bhaan suulhgia' gu gɨ' suudai' bhaan mi'p bhaan baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ' suudai' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix vɨgɨ jodai gu ñi'ook maakobh gu ñi'ook maakobh vaik gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't dhi'; gio ba' ko'kmarak mi'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhaan mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax; gio ba' bhaan tu jiim na ja'p bɨtaa'n gu vaakax ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ga'ra' maakobh gu ñi'ook jix vɨgɨ jodai bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix vɨgɨ jodai; gio ba' maakobh ka't gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr na ba' bɨtaa'n suudai' buusñi.

Jano' ba' gu chin tɨɨt suudai' buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam novɨ maa'nkar busaak na ba' jiix; gio ba' ka't gu chin gu ñi'ook novɨ maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr ka't gio bhaan gu chin bɨɨx jix duñia' cham.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu ñi'ook mi'p bɨtaa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't novɨ maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ novɨ maa'nkar gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu jiim jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x bɨɨx gu ñi'ook xikoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' duñia' mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio mambhɨɨx suudai' buusñi jix vɨgɨ jodai; gio ba' suudai' buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm ka't maakobh; mi' dhɨr suudai' buusñi bhaan mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas jixchamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ tu jiim gu vaak jixchamaam gu novɨ o'nsop; gio ba' gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook gu vaak tas buusñi bhaan saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu iram suudai' buusñi; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨx gu ñi'ook jix duu gu Salomoon na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maachim gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi'p jix bhai'x gook; gio ba' gook a'sak gu ñi'ook gook mi'p bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gook a'sak gook jix vɨgɨ na ba' gu ñi'ook gook mi'p bhaan ɨɨbhidham.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx suudai' buusñi bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ' suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax bɨtaa'n gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx gu iram jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Jordaan gu oidha' u'u gat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sukkot gu Sartaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon cham gu jodai' na jix uam bɨx jix gɨ'.

Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Salomoon bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix uam jodai gu vaak na jix bhai' bhaan mi'p gu takarui' tɨkiix gio jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam daa'nkar tai na jix tas jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ tu jiim jixchamaam o'nsop vupui bhaan; gio ba' bɨɨx tɨtɨɨya jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix uam jodai; gio ba' gio jix uam jodai kiki'ñgob gu vaak pai' kiki'ñgob vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Salomoon gu Dabii gu taat ka't maachim jix toja jodai jix uam jodai jix dhaas bɨx jix nukadham gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Salomoon daraa gu Israeel bɨx ɨɨbhidham bopxi'ñ chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu Jerusalem na ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios kiicham gu Dabii gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Etanim kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs bɨx daraa gu Israeel jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi'p vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel ka't gu ñi'ook mi'p bɨɨx vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu vaak na jix bhai' kakneer gu vaakax gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios pai' gu vaak pai' bɨtaa'n.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ko'kmarak bhaan pai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na ɨɨbhidham dɨr xidhuu vupui bhaan gu' cham jix duñia' dɨr gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' matgɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gook gu jodai ka't gu ñi'ook gu Moisees gu oreb pai' gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk moor gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan moor xidhuu toov gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' kuiñcha toov; na gu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Salomoon; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukgam.
Jano' ba' gu Yo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix daa na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu vupui jix bhai' aa' bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' bɨx gu Israeel ka't tɨɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu chin gu Dabii gu taat bɨɨx gu novɨ tu' jix duñia' bham.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu Ejipto cham kiicham bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dabii na ba' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu taat jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' xoi'kam gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx jix duñia' aagak.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu mar gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't tu ñi'ook; na jix duñia' tu' pai' gu Dabii gu taat daakat atooxkor gu Israeel na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook pai' na ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx taata'n tattat na pai' dhuuk jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Salomoon vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Israeel jix duñia' gu noobh gu tɨkɨr.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p tu' jiix gu tɨkɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' nuuka'n ñi'ook na jix bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu duukam vupui bhaan tu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu Dabii gu taat tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu chin bɨɨx gu novɨ jix duñia' na ja'p dhi' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu Dabii gu taat bham; gio ba' cham gu chio'ñ tu' vupui bhaan tu' atooxkor gu Israeel bɨɨx jix duñia' gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p tu' vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Dabii gu taat.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu'r gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu oidha' gu Miren gu tɨkɨr cham tu' jɨ'xdha'; gio ba' dhi' gu vaak tu'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam soi'm tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tɨiñ jix duñia' tu ñi'ook soi'm tu duukam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu'.
Na gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukaa' gu tanoolh bhaan dhi' gu vaak bhaan dhi' pai' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr soi'm tu duukam dhi' pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam soi'm tu duukam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; na pai' dhuuk dhi' pai' gio tu' pai' ba'bhak dɨr gu tɨkɨr; na gu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' bhɨɨya' uañi'ñ bhaan tɨtmo gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk aa' daraibu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan dhi' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu tɨkɨr tu duukam jix bhai'x bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook jir bhai' na ba' jix maa jurtu'nka' bɨx bhai'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ja'tkam gu Israeel bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ uañi'ñ bhaan tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' dhi' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu oidha' chɨɨdak tattat.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tɨkɨr jix duñia' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ bhaan tu' dhi' pai' gu tɨɨgɨ' uañi'ñ na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr uañi'ñka' uañi'ñ tu duukam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel jix bhai' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' maa'n dhuuk bhaan gu oidha' chɨɨdak gu ja'tkam gu maa'nkar.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu oidha' bhɨɨya' bhiogi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' obhɨɨ'ñ mia'n gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr no'x ko'kdai' ka't.
Na pai' dhuuk bɨx soi'm bɨx ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk no'x gu i'ii'ñ gu noobh dhi' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr ba'bhak gu vaak na jix bhai' uañi'ñka' maa'n jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ tu' jix maati'; na gu' tu' jix maati' gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ; mi' dhɨr.
Na ba' na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu tanoolh bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' tu' chɨɨdak taata'n tattat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham gu ja'tkam gu Israeel bhɨɨya' tɨbiap oi'ñga'n kuiñcha gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook; gio ba' daraibu' dhi' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr ba'bhak gu vaak na jix bhai' jix duu jurtu'nka' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ja'tkam mii' dhɨr bhɨɨya' tu' duuñ; na ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' na ja'p gu ja'tkam gu Israeel kɇɇkɇ' gu tɨɨgɨ' bhaan dhi' gu vaak tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt tu' tɨip gu Jawatan Dios bhaan kiicham tu' bhaan gu vaak tu' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr soi'm ñi'ook Jawatan jix duu gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ bhaan tu' na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ cham tu' bhaan kɨɨsa' vupui bhaan bhaamki'ñdha' na ba' gu oidha' ka't mia'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' pai' ua'tulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu oidha' obhɨɨ'ñ baabuk gu ñi'ook tu' bhaan gu oidha' tu' chɨɨdak tattat bhaan kiicham tu' gu vaak tu' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr ba'bhak gu vaak na jix bhai' soi'm ñi'ook Jawatan jix duu gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' uañi'ñka' gu ja'tkam ka't uañi'ñ bhaan tu' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bhaan tu'; gio ba' jix duu xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch baabuk gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu ja'tkam gu maa'nkar tu' jix buusñi gu Ejipto tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk jodai.
Na gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam soi'm tu duukam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx mii' dhɨr tu'.

Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu' gu maa'nkar bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' na ja'p tu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Moisees tu duukam na pai' dhuuk jix buusñi taata'n tattat gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu gu Salomoon bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨx dhi' soi'm ñi'ook Jawatan jix búup gu ñi'ook kɨkbok vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu noobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook tɨɨt jix bhai' aa' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel bham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' bɨx ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook bɨx iimchuda gu Moisees tu duukam tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't bɨɨx no'ch gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p ka't bɨɨx gu Dios tattat; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' gu i'ii'ñ bhaan na ba' bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk jix aa'ñdhix gu i'ii'ñ tattat.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios mia'n gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh gu tukaa' na ba' kuiñcha tu duukam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na ba' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jiim ñi'ook kavɨk nukadham gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam makgɨrxi'ñdha' makgɨrxi gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x gu vaakax chamaam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x kakneer; gio ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bhaan duu gu gɨ'kora' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't vupui bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' makgɨrxi maa'nkar tai bhaan; na gu' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix vɨgɨ jodai ka't vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix ali' cham maa'nkar tai bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix duu mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel jix gɨ' dɨr na ja'p ba'k gu amat bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Ejipto vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios kɨɨv gu tanoolh kɨɨv gu tanoolh dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix bhai'x gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix bɨɨx duu dhi' jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu Dabii tu duukam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Salomoon ka't gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak vaak ja'tkam bɨx gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi'ñ gu Salomoon gookim jix duñia' na ja'p ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gabaoon.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' naak soi'm soi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr tu' dhi' gu vaak tu' na ba' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas; jano' ba' no'm gu vupui gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p jix jiim gu Dabii gu taat gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu vupui bɨx tu'x tu' jix duñia' nukadham ñi'ook kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu Yo gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel na ba' bɨɨx tas na ja'p tu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu taat bham; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu chio'ñ atooxkor gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ma'nkam cham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook ua'tulhi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' dhagia'; gio ba' dhi' gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' vupui bhaan tu' gu Israeel ka't bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu vaak ka't jix duñia' no'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu oidha' dhi' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix buusñi tattat gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios o'lhia; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon ka't gook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak vaak ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' na ba' gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk ka't jix uam jodai gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon jix maa gu iram gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh gu oidha' gu Galilea.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu iram gu Tiro na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh gu Salomoon ka't jix maa cham.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh dhi' jix maa xibhɨk jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu oidha' gu Kabul bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu iram gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' chamaam gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namki'ñdha' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Millo vaak jodai gu Jerusalem gu asor gu Megiddo gu Geser.
Jano' ba' gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto ka't jix duñia' gu Geser gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix koi gu Kananeos oi'ñka' kiicham mar u'vɨ gu u'vɨ gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon gu Geser gu Bet-oron.
Jano' ba' gu Baalat gu Tadmor gu oidha' oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx jɨ'dɨlh pai' gu Salomoon ga'ra' jɨ'dɨlh gu ja'tkam kavaayo bɨx gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu Liibano bɨx gu oidha' aapi'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Amorreos gu eteos gu Pereseos gu ebeos gu Jebuseos cham jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon bɨɨx namki'ñdha' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham chiñia' gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' gu Salomoon ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan buimɨi jix duñia' mambhɨɨx mi'p bhaan gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon kiicham gu Dabii gu vaak gu Salomoon ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jano' ba' pai'x gu Millo.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon vaik mui'kim oi'ñga' maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan ka't vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios mi' dhɨr gu vaak ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esioon-geber ju'ñdharan gu Elat gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo gu oidha' gu Edom.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu iram tu duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx tu duukam gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Opir jix bhɨɨ jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cha'tmam aichdhak gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu Oyendo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Seba gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Salomoon gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix ai gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai jix gɨ' gu jodai a'bhar; gio ba' na ja'p suudai' u'va gu Salomoon bɨx gu i'ii'ñ ga'ra'.
Jano' ba' gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' matgɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' cham gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Seba jix ñi' bɨx matda' gu Salomoon gu vaak ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook tu duukam dhi' jajannulhi'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu'r tu' gu oidha' tu'x matda'.
Ba' jix aa' gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm tɨbiap gu vupui jix duñia' buupui tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't; gio ba' jix gɨ' matda' xoi'kam gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu' ka't naak.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ dhi' ja'tkam tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' matda'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ba' atooxkor gu Israeel; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dha' bɨɨx tas gu Israeel tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai'.

Jano' ba' jix maa gu gɨ'kora' chamaam gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai a'bhar; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' na ja'p gu Seba jix maa gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu iram ka't jix uam jodai gu Opir gio gu Opir gu bhóogɨt gu u'u gu jodai a'bhar.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu u'u gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu vaak gu ñi'ook gio na ba'; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va gu u'u tu' buupui bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Seba bɨx gu Salomoon jix maa na ja'p gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon; gio ba' ka't gu oidha' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai gu Salomoon ga'ra' oi'ñga' ka't gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Arabia gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix uam jodai; gio ba' jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai maa'n vaik jix uam jodai; gio ba' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Liibano.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu gɨ'kora' atooxkor gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ga'ra' atooxkor jix bhai'x ka't; gio ba' baasɨ'n ga'ra' mia'n gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan mi'p gook.
Jano' ba' mi'p gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan baasɨ'n; gio ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't gu ñi'ook atooxkor nɨidhim.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'i gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon jix duñia' jix uam jodai bɨx gu vaak gu Liibano ka't jix uam jodai; gio ba' cham ka't jix toja jodai; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon cham ka't jix duñia'.

Na gu' na gu' gu gɨ'kora' ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam busaak gu gɨ' suudai' gu Tarsis bɨɨx gu iram; gio ba' jix duñia' vaik gu Tarsis jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' namkɨm matda'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon na ba' matda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga'; gio ba' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook kavaayo.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam kavaayo; gio ba' ga'ra' jix bhai'x jix dhaas jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem jix toja jodai na ja'p gu jodai gɨ' u'u kavɨk na ja'p chiiw gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo bhiibgich gu Salomoon gu Ejipto; na gu' chu'p jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' kavaayo bhiibgich.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam busaak gu Ejipto jix toja jodai kavaayo chamaam mambhɨɨx; gio ba' gu novɨ bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu eteos gu Siria.
Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon mumua'da' gu u'vɨ jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu Moab gu Ammoon gu Idumea gu Sidoon gu eteas.

Jano' ba' chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' cham ba'k tu' jɨjɨkgɨm gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Salomoon bɨɨx xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ vaik gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu u'vɨ gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Salomoon ka't jix bhai'x gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ cham ka't bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ gu taat gu Dabii.
Na gu' na gu' gu Salomoon chɨ'ɨɨk gu Astarot gu Jawatan Dios gu Sidonios gu Milkom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ammonitas.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Salomoon cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu Dabii gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Salomoon jix bhai'x gu Kêmos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moab gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu Molok gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' jix duu na ba' bɨx gu u'vɨ jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' bhaam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Salomoon na gu' ka't gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel ka't gook mui'kim.
Jano' ba' ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dhi' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham nukadham jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon; na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu' cham ñi'ook na jix bhaan ñi'ook kavɨk tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu' kapbhai' tu duukam.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' gu novɨ gu mar.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ gu mar gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Jerusalem tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon gu Adad gu Idumeo gu ɨ'ɨr vaak ja'tkam ka't gu Edom.
Na pai' dhuuk na gu' na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii ka't gu Edom jix tɨ'ɨ gu Joab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham koko'kam bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Edom.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam masaa'n jix daa gu Joab bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Edom; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Adad bɨɨx dhɨt gu chio'ñ gu Idumeos tu duukam gu taat ka't gu Ejipto; gio ba' ka't jano' ba' gu Adad gu ñi'ook jix ali'.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Madiaan tɨɨtɨs gu Paraan; gio ba' dhaagɨk baidhak gu chichio'ñ gu Paraan tɨɨtɨs gu Ejipto gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto jix maa gu vaak nɨi'ñchudat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Adad jix gɨ' nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan gu Faraoon jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu ja'tkam tɨɨmo' gu ja'tkam gu Tapnes.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu Tapnes gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu Genubat gu Tapnes gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Faraoon; gio ba' ka't gu Genubat gu vaak gu Faraoon tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' tɨiñ gu Adad gu Ejipto gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tattat ka't jix koi gu Joab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Adad gu Faraoon; gio ba' tu' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' uañi'ñ gu oidha' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham tu'; jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx jix duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Resoon gu mar gu Eliada ka't jix duñia' gu Adad-eser gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba.

Jano' ba' jix duu ka't gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bhaan dua'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chu'p na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii gu Soba; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu Damasko jix daa tu' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu Damasko.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Israeel bɨx gu tanoolh gu Salomoon; na gu' ka't cham bhai' bɨɨx gu Adad na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Siria.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat gu Eprateo gu Sereda tu duukam gu Salomoon gu naan gu Serba gu u'vɨ ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' kuiñcha gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ'kora' ka't dhi'; gio ba' gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook gu Millo gu ñi'ook kiicham gu Dabii gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jeroboam ka't jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Salomoon biapma' ka't gu chio'ñ bɨx gu vaak gu Josee.

Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gamai' gu Jeroboam gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Aiias gu Silonita; gio ba' ka't jix bhaan dhaas bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr mi'p gook yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aiias ga'ra' bhaan bapaalh.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jeroboam; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu' mambhɨɨx bapaalh; na gu' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu novɨ gu Salomoon tu' mambhɨɨx bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Jerusalem kiicham tu' bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba'.

Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' tɨtda:―Cha'pim jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Astarot gu Jawatan Dios gu Sidonios gu Kêmos gu Jawatan Dios gu Moab gu Molok gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt na ba' duñia' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui ñi'ook kavɨk na ja'p jix duu gu Dabii gu taat.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu noobh gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam tu' nukadham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu novɨ gu mar tu' mambhɨɨx bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ na ba' tu duukam gu Dabii jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tanoolh vupui bhaan tu' gu Jerusalem kiicham tu' na ba' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu'x gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ ka' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu ka't tu' jix duñia' naak bɨx tu'x tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt tu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui nukadham ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Dabii tu duukam tu' jix duñia' bɨndak tu' gu vaak gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Dabii tu' kapbhai' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kai' gu Dabii kuiñcha dhi' gu' cham na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon kooda' gu Jeroboam gu' kɨkbo gu Jeroboam gu Ejipto gu Sisak gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto juruuñ gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm koi'm gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon bɨx tu'x matda' cham ua'ñix u'uan gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Salomoon jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem bhaan bɨx gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu oo'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Salomoon bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' kiicham gu taat gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Roboam gu mar.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Roboam gu Sikêm; na gu' bɨx gu Israeel ka't tɨbiap gu Sikêm na ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'.
Na gu' ka't na ja'p jix kai gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat ka't gu Ejipto na gu' ka't jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon jix daa gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ tɨɨt; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Jeroboam bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Roboam bham.
Jano' ba' gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' gu' jano' tu' gu ñi'ook juantu'n gu taat gu ñi'ook jix dhaas bhaan no'ch tu'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik gu tanoolh tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam ka't.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx daraa dhi' vupui bhaan gu Salomoon gu taat na pai' dhuuk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu duukam dhi' gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu ñi'ook ñiokda' tu' tu juan na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Gu' gu' tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨklhi'ñga'n jix maa jix bhɨɨ bɨɨx biipibop jix duñia' bɨɨx mi'p vupui bhaan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' bham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu taat jix dhaas bhaan no'ch.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' biipibop a'ga jix duñia' bɨɨx tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha'; gu' tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix ali' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu taat.
Jano' ba' jano' gu taat gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu' tu'; gio ba' gu taat naaka'n bɨɨx gu' tu' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' vaik gu tanoolh suudai' u'va gu Jeroboam bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Roboam; gio ba' bhaan gu gɨ'kora' ka't jix duñia' bham; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' vaik gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtda:―Cha'pim daraa jix maa.
Ba' jix aa' jurtu'nka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam biipibop bham; gio ba' gu taat gu' tu'; mi' dhɨr gu taat naaka'n bɨɨx gu' tu' bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' cham jix kai gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam; na gu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Aiias gu Silonita gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bɨx gu ja'tkam jix ñi' gu gɨ'kora' cham ka't naak jix aa' dhi' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n tañia' no'ch bɨɨx gu Dabii cham tañia' gu maa'nkar gu mar gu Isaii; mi' dhɨr gu Israeel dhi' gu Probee jano' gu vaak gu Dabii jano' ba' gu Israeel ka't dhi'.
Gu' gu' jix gɨ'kora' gu Roboam bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam bhañ gu Adoram ka't bhaan bopxi'ñ; gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Israeel jix koi; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix gu Israeel gu vaak gu Dabii bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ka't tɨiñ bɨx gu Israeel gu Jeroboam ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mɨjɨ tɨɨt gu ñi'ook tu' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel cham bopxi'ñ gu vaak gu Dabii gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Roboam suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem jum daa'ñ bɨx gu vaak gu Judaa bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin chamaam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham gu vaak gu Israeel oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon.
Gu' gu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Semeiias gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨx gu vaak gu Judaa gu Benjamiin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook maa'n gu vaak; na gu' dhi' tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios suulh jix bɨɨx duu jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeroboam gu Sikêm gu kavɨk gu Epraim jix daa; gio ba' gamai' gu Penuel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeroboam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jano' gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' tu' dhi' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem; na gu' gu i'ii'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan gu Roboam gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa yaa' tu' gu Roboam gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n jix uam jodai gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix bhai'x jix duñia' gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Israeel tu' jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas maa'n gu Bet-el jix dhaas gu Dan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't bua' uañi'ñ; na gu' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan maa'n bɨɨx ka'm gu Dan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ja'tkam cham jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeroboam jix bhai'x jurtu'nka' gu Judaa; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jix duu gu Bet-el gu vaak na jix bhai' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n ka't gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gio gu Bet-el jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't.

Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't gu ñi'ook gu Bet-el gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x ka't gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va gu Judaa gu Bet-el; gio ba' kua' gu Jeroboam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba'.

Ba' jix aa' tu ñi'ook bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu vaak gu Dabii gu mar tɨɨgim gu Josiiyas gu vaak na jix bhai' bhaan tu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan tu'; jano' ba' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook o'oo gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix maa nɨi'ñchudat bham; gio ba' dhi' nɨi'ñchudat gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maatai bhaan gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Jeroboam jix kai gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't duuñ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Bet-el jix duñia' gu novɨ dɨr jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu' gu novɨ ka't bhaan cham.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'aa maatai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jurtu'nka' nɨi'ñchudat gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' kai'ch:―Dho gu gɨ'kora' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu' gu novɨ ka't jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p va'k.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix ai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak jugi tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak cham bɨndak tu' jugi gu takarui' tu' i'i gu suudai' dhi' pai'.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' cham jugi gu takarui' tu' i'i gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt cham gu bhóogɨt pai' ka't tɨbiap gu Bet-el.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bet-el jix bhai'x jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan suudai' u'va gu mar gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Bet-el; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gio gu taat gu ñi'ook ka't tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu taat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt ka't gu ma'nkam gu bhóogɨt pai' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨbiap gu Judaa.
Ba' jix aa' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ.

Jano' ba' jiimchu' bhaan gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ka't daakat bɨtaa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Judaa jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak jiim gu takarui'.
Gu' gu' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨndak tu' tu jiim bɨndak; mi' dhɨr tu' jugi gu takarui' tu' i'ya' gu suudai' bɨndak dhi' pai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham jugi gu takarui' tu' i'i gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gio jix duñia' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan na ja'p tu' nobii'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr bɨndak gu vaak na ba' gu takarui' gu suudai'; gu' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix jugi gu takarui' gu vaak jix i'i gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' ka't kua' gu vaak na jix bhai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨbiap gu Judaa bham; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't.
Gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' gu suudai' pai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't tu ñi'ook cham gu takarui' tu' gu suudai' cham gu chuukug tukga'n tattat.
Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't gu ñi'ook tu jiim gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maavɨt gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu chuukug ka't baas gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook ka't ju'ñdharan maavɨt gio ka't ju'ñdharan gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu chuukug ka't baas gu bhóogɨt maavɨt ka't ju'ñdharan gu chuukug; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gui'p kiicham pai' jix bhai'x jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix daa.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' maavɨt tu' jix bhai'x jix koi jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'.
Ba' jix aa' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook maavɨt mi'p ju'ñdharan gu chuukug; gio ba' maavɨt cham ka't gu chuukug tu' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu chuukug gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix bhai'x suudai' u'va kiicham na ba'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu chuukug tukga'n; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook xibhɨk.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr a'lhiok gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam bham; na pai' dhuuk tu' vaak jodai tukga'n jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr o'oo ju'ñdharan.

Ba' jix aa' na gu' cham jix duñia' ɨlhdham jiiñak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Bet-el bhaan bɨx gu vaak jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jɨ'dɨlh gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeroboam cham bhai' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' va'k duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ja'tkam ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't kuiñcha uañi'ñ gu vaak gu Jeroboam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Abiiyas gu mar gu Jeroboam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jeroboam gu u'vɨ; na gu' bamii' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' cham tu' gu u'vɨ gu Jeroboam tu' gu Silo; na gu Aiias jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' ka't gu gɨ'kora' bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ mambhɨɨx gu takarui' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu'; na tu' dhi'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu u'vɨ gu Jeroboam; gio ba' jix búup ka't gu Silo suudai' u'va gu vaak gu Aiias; mi' dhɨr cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aiias gu vupui jix bhai'x kuiñcha.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Aiias; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu Jeroboam ɨlhdham gu mar ka'ook; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk daraibu' ɨlhdham.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Aiias jix kai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt na pai' dhuuk ki'ñgob; gio ba' ba'k gu u'vɨ gu Jeroboam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' tu' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jeroboam; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam tu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Dabii tu' kapbhai' tu'; gio ba' tu' cham jix duñia' na ja'p gu Dabii tu duukam nukadham gu ñi'ook jix jiim tu' bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui.
