Jano' ba' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' bhaan bɨx jix duñia' va'k tu'; na tu' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu' bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham bhai' bhaan gu vaak gu Jeroboam tu' gu Jeroboam bɨx na ja'p jix bhai'x gu Israeel; gio ba' gu vaak gu Jeroboam na ja'p bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook.
Na vaak jodai gu Jeroboam kiicham jugi gagai'; gio ba' vaak jodai yooxi' jugi jix duñia' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' bamii' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak; na baakɨk tɨɨt kiicham koi.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu Jeroboam; na gu' tu' gaagam jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu vaak gu Jeroboam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix búup gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel jix duñia' gu vaak gu Jeroboam dhi' gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jano'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu suudai'; na gu' jix duñia' gu Israeel dhi' jix bhai' gu oidha' ka't jix maa tattat baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam uañi'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu Jeroboam jix búup ka't suudai' u'va gu Tirsa; gio ba' baakɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Israeel jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu novɨ tu duukam gu Aiias jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeroboam gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' bɨx ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu Jeroboam jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' dhaibu gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tattat jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Nadab gu mar.

Jano' ba' gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon jix gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; na pai' dhuuk oo'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Roboam na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem kiicham gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel na ba' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Naama gu Ammonita.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Judaa cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tattat gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gio gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' bɨx jix bhai'x bɨtaa'n bɨx gu u'u.
Jano' ba' ka't gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' tu' jix duu jurtu'nka' bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios ka't baas vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam jix tɨ'ɨ gu Sisak gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto bhaan gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak vaak ja'tkam bɨx; gio ba' gio bɨx gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai gu Salomoon ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu pai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam jix maa gu noobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob gu vaak vaak ja'tkam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Roboam bɨx tu'x cham ua'ñix gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Roboam gu Jeroboam bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Roboam bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' bɨɨx tattat kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Naama gu Ammonita; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Abiam gu mar.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat gu Abiam kua'da' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Maakâ mar u'vɨ gu Abisalom.
Jano' ba' jix jiim bɨx uañi'ñ gu taat ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook va'k; gio ba' cham ka't gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ gu Dabii gu taat.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Dabii jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem.
Na gu' na gu' gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios matgɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Uriia gu eteo.
Jano' ba' ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Roboam gu Jeroboam bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abiam bɨx tu'x cham ua'ñix u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Abiam gu Jeroboam.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Abiam bɨɨx tattat gu ñi'ook kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Asa gu mar pai'.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu Jeroboam gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Asa kua'da' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' oo'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Maakâ mar u'vɨ gu Abisalom.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Asa gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu Dabii gu taat.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bɨx tattat gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu naan gu Maakâ gu ñi'ook na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Asa gu naan gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan bhi'ñbak gu Kedroon.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; gio ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu Asa ka't na ba' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu taat ka't; gio ba' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Asa gu Baasa gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gu Baasa gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bhaan gu Judaa gu Rama na ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buus tu' baakɨi gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu Asa bɨx jix toja jodai jix uam jodai ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak vaak ja'tkam do'ñcho gu noobh tu duukam bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa gu Ben-adad gu mar gu Tabrimoon gu mar gu esioon gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu Damasko bham.

Jano' ba' ñi'ook na jix bhaan cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' jootsa' jix toja jodai jix uam jodai; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Baasa gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel na ba'.

Jano' ba' gu Ben-adad gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa bhañ chiñia' chugi'ñ ga'ra' bhaan jɨ'dɨlh gu Israeel tu' naaka'n gu Aioon gu Dan gu Abel-bet-maakâ bɨx gu Kinnerot bɨɨx bɨx gu oidha' gu Neptalii.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ dhi' gu Baasa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Rama juruuñ gu Tirsa.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Judaa cham; gio ba' gu Rama gu jodai gu u'u bɨɨx gu Baasa gu ñi'ook pai'x gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa bɨɨx gu Gabaa gu Benjamiin gu Mispa.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Asa bɨx gu kavɨk bɨx tu'x jɨ'dɨlh pai'x cham bɨx ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu' gu ñi'ook tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Asa bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' bɨɨx tattat kiicham gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Josapat gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Nadab gu mar gu Jeroboam kua'da' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Israeel gook oi'ñga' gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jiim gu bhóogɨt gu taat uañi'ñ bɨɨx uañi'ñ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Baasa gu mar gu Aiia ka't gu vaak gu Issakâr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; gio ba' tu' naaka'n gu Baasa gu Gibbetoon ka't gu Pilisteos; na gu' gu Nadab bɨx gu Israeel ko'kmarak mia'n gu Gibbetoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baasa vaik oi'ñga' gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix gɨ'kora' pai'.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p suudai' u'va oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' naaka'n bɨx gu vaak gu Jeroboam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na jix do'ig gu Jeroboam bɨɨx ka'm jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu duukam gu Aiias gu Silonita.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam ka't bɨɨx uañi'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nadab bɨx tu'x cham bɨx ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Asa gu Baasa gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' vaik oi'ñga' gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Baasa gu mar gu Aiia bhaan bɨx gu Israeel gu Tirsa; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' maakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu Jeroboam uañi'ñ bɨɨx uañi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeuu gu mar gu anani bhaan gu Baasa bham.
Na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo' tu' gu ñi'ook gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Jeroboam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel daak bɨɨx uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Baasa gu vaak; gio ba' gu vaak na ja'p gu vaak gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat.
Na gu Baasa ua'tulhi'ñ jix koi kiicham jugi gagai'; gio ba' ua'tulhi'ñ jix koi yooxi' jugi jix duñia' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baasa tu'x gu kavɨk cham bɨx ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Baasa bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' gu Tirsa; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Ela gu mar.

Jano' ba' jix duu cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Jeuu jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu anani ka't jix duñia' bhaan gu Baasa gio bhaan gu vaak bɨɨx bɨx cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios daak bɨɨx buimɨi gu noobh na ba' jum duu na ja'p gu vaak gu Jeroboam; na gu' ka't.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Ela gu mar gu Baasa bhaan gu Israeel gu Tirsa; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' gook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu duukam gu Simri tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' kua' gu Tirsa i'i jix bhai'x gu vaak gu Arsa gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu Tirsa.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Simri naaka'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga' gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook juruuñ daakat atooxkor naaka'n bɨx gu vaak gu Baasa cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Simri bɨx gu vaak gu Baasa jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Baasa tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jeuu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx uañi'ñ gu Baasa uañi'ñ gu Ela gu mar bɨɨx uañi'ñ tu' jix duu uañi'ñ gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ela bɨx tu'x cham bɨx ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Simri jix gɨ'kora' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu Tirsa; gio ba' gu ja'tkam ka't yooxi' bhaan gu Gibbetoon kiicham gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam ka't yooxi' jix kai a'ga; gio ba' gu Simri tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix koi gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel jix búup gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel gu Omri ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham yooxi'.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Omri gu Gibbetoon bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tirsa.
Gu' gu' ñɨi'ñ gu Simri gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gu vaak vaak ja'tkam gu tai gu vaak baidhak; gio ba' jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ ka't duñia' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jiim gu bhóogɨt gu Jeroboam uañi'ñ duñia' uañi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Simri cham bɨx ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Tibni gu mar gu Ginet na ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Omri.
Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Omri gu Tibni gu mar gu Ginet; gio ba' gu Tibni jix koi gu Omri ka't gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook maa'n gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Omri bhaan gu Israeel jix gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Tirsa jix gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Semer gu kavɨk gu Samaria gook cha'tmam jix toja jodai gu kavɨk; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham pai'x gu Samaria gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Semer gu Jawatan ka't mii' dhɨr gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Omri cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx jix duñia' va'k.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix jiim bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat uañi'ñ bɨɨx uañi'ñ gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bɨɨx duiñxim.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Omri tu'x cham bɨx ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Omri jix koox bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' gu Samaria; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Akâb gu mar.
Jano' ba' kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Akâb gu mar gu Omri bhaan gu Israeel oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Akâb gu mar gu Omri bhaan gu Israeel gu Samaria gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Akâb gu mar gu Omri jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx jix bɨɨx duu va'k.
Na gu' na gu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiim uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu Jesabel mar u'vɨ gu Etbaal gu gɨ'kora' gu Sidonios ka't gu Baal jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duu jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baal vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal pai'x gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu Akâb gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Akâb duñia' daak gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel va'k jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu iel gu Bet-el gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerikoo; gio ba' gu Abiram maa'nkam mar gu Segub gu mar kuugalhdha' jix dhaas kiki'ñgob; mi' dhɨr jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita ka't gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Galaad gu Akâb; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel vupui bhaan dhi' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhuuk tu' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas buusñi jix duu gu Kerit vupui bhaan gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' i'i jix duu; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' jix maa jugi.
Jano' ba' jix duu ka't tu' jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ju'ñdharan jix duu gu Kerit va'k gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu chuukug gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh gu takarui' gu chuukug gu xumai; gio ba' jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhɨt gu tanoolh jix duu; na gu' cham ka't bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' bamii' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sarepta gu Sidoon; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu u'vɨ ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup ka't gu Sarepta; gio ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob kiicham gu u'vɨ ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam ka't; mi' dhɨr jup tɨɨt jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' vaaso na ba'.
Ba' jix aa' jiimchu' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt; gio ba' jix duñia' gio gu chin gu takarui' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham no'ñ gu takarui'; na no'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu'; jano' ba' jano' gook na ba' ba'k na ba' tu' na ba' gu mar vaak jodai.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch choo'n; mi' dhɨr tu' gu vupui na ja'p tu ñi'ook; gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu takarui' bɨtaa'n maatai; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix duu na ba' tu' na ba' gu mar.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' bɨ'ñdhatu' bɨɨx ka'm mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios maa'n dhuuk bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' ka't tu' jix duu na ja'p gu Eliiyas; gio ba' jix jugi gu vaak mui'x gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' bɨ'ñdhatu' jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Eliiyas.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka'ook gu mar gu vaak ko'kdai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook no'ñ tu' bɨndak gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tɨbiap tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook chɨ'ñchoka' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi gu mar.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu mar; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim pai' ka't jix dhaas bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' jiiñkɨk gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gu vaak tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook vaik mui'kim tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ dhi' gu ñi'ook ba'k.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kai gu ñi'ook gu Eliiyas gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k.
Ba' jix aa' dhaagɨk gu Eliiyas gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak jix maa gu naan gu Eliiyas; gio ba' gu mar jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu Eliiyas; gio ba' jano' kakasnira' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu'r gu chin.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mui'x gu tanoolh ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas vaik oi'ñga' bham; gio ba' tu' ba'm gu Akâb tu' dhuuk bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Eliiyas jix duñia' gu Akâb; gio ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' bhiogi' gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' gu Akâb jup tɨɨt gu Abdiias gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu Abdiias ka't jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na gu' na pai' dhuuk gu Jesabel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Abdiias jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan mambhɨɨx gu takarui' gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Akâb gu Abdiias; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx suudai' buusñi gu suudai' bɨx; na bakia' bɨɨx gu oidha' kavaayo na ba' cham ba'r cham gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu Abdiias ka't.
Jano' ba' jiimchu' gu Abdiias gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu Eliiyas; gio ba' na ja'p o'lhia'n bhaan gu vupui jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham tu' gu Jawatan gu Eliiyas.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' gu Eliiyas.
Ba' jix aa' gu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ na ba' tu' kapbhai' tu duukam gu novɨ gu Akâb na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' pai' gu Jawatan cham ka't; gio ba' kai'ch:―Dho cham tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam tu' cham tu' jix duñia' gaagam.
Jano' ba' jano' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Eliiyas.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ka't tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' pai' tu' cham; gio ba' bai'ñpu' tu' jix maa gu Akâb cham gu ñi'ook mu'aa; mi' dhɨr tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dɨr.

Na pai' dhuuk cham tu' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu Jesabel mu'aa jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios mambhɨɨx gu takarui' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jano' tu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Eliiyas; na ba'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ vupui bhaan dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Abdiias ka't jix ai bɨɨx gu Akâb jix maa aa'ñdham; gio ba' gu Akâb suudai' u'va jix ai bɨɨx gu Eliiyas.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Akâb jix ñi' gu Eliiyas gu Akâb; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu jodai' na jix uam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' cham gu jodai' na jix uam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook tu' gu vaak gu taat gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baales.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' bɨx gu Israeel gu kavɨk gu Karmelo mambhɨɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Baal jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan kua'da' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jesabel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Akâb bhañ bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jum daa'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu kavɨk gu Karmelo.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eliiyas bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook tu' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Baal; jano' ba' gu ja'tkam cham jix aa' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Eliiyas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Baal cham tu'x jai'ch mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu vaakax maa'n bapaalh bhaan gu u'u gu' cham gu tai bɨtaa'n; gio ba' tu' gu vaakax bhaan gu u'u gu tai bɨtaa'n.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu tai ka't gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam jix aa' bham; jano' ba' xoi'kam tu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Baal; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu' cham gu tai bɨtaa'n.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu vaakax ka't jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Baal dɨr gu xibh bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh bham; gio ba' gu Baal gu' cham ka't gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook mia'n jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gu Eliiyas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr juraa'n tu' gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jiiñak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jurtu'nka' bɨɨx ka'm gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar cham ka't gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu'; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu Eliiyas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Jakob ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham gu Israeel ka't gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨɨx gu jodai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gook jix daa gu kai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'u gu vaakax bapaalh jix dhaas bhaan gu u'u.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix bhuup maakobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan gu u'u; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' jix duu; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' jix duu jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' ka't gio gu suudai'.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas jix duñia' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Eliiyas; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Israeel ka't gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' jix duñia' tu duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' tu'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan gu u'u gu jodai oo' gu suudai' mi'p.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam ia'rɨ bhaan gu vupui gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Baal cham gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' gu Eliiyas jix duu gu Kisoon.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliiyas gu Akâb; gio ba' jix duñia' jugi i'i; na gu' jix gɨ' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Akâb jix tɨ'ɨ jugi i'i; gio ba' gu Eliiyas jix tɨ'ɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Karmelo; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' jix dhaas gu vupui tɨjɨɨ'ñ kɨkbok.

Ba' jix aa' jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu gɨ' suudai'; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ jix aa'; jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch cham tu'; gio ba' a'ga; mi' dhɨr kɨɨv mui'kim.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n toov na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu gɨ' suudai'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' gu Akâb; na gu' dhuuk cham tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't kua' dhi' gu tɨkɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tɨbaa'ñ gu jɨvɨl; gio ba' ka't dhuuk; mi' dhɨr gu Akâb suudai' u'va gu Jesreel.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Eliiyas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Akâb bɨɨx ka'm gu Jesreel.
Jano' ba' gu Akab jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jesabel bɨx gu Eliiyas ka't gu ñi'ook na ja'p ka't jix koi bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bhañ gu Jesabel gu Eliiyas mattuda' bham; gio ba' xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu xibh dhi' gu kavɨk tu' cham ka't gu ñi'ook na ja'p maa'n.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix búup ka't gu oidha' suudai' u'va gu Beer-seba gu Judaa jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt suudai' u'va jix daa bɨtaa'n; gio ba' koi jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ; na cham jix duñia' tu' tutkɨ tattat.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨtaa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' nobii'ñ gu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr bamii' jugi.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' bhaan vaaso gu suudai'; gio ba' jix jugi jix i'i koox.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gookim jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' bamii' jugi; na gu' gu bhóogɨt tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix búup jix jugi jix i'i; gio ba' jix jiim bɨɨx gu kavɨk mii' dhɨr jugi oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa' bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios gu oreb.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jumpa'n pai' jix duñia' gu tukaa'; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Eliiyas.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' tɨtda:―Cha'pim ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' jix koi jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' na ba' gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix buus mai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu jɨvɨl gu kakkavɨk jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't gu jɨvɨl; gio ba' bhaan gu jɨvɨl gi'ndukɨ; gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't gi'ndukɨ.
Jano' ba' bhaan gi'ndukɨ gu tai; gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't gu tai; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu tai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix kai gu Eliiyas jix bhaan dhaas gu vupui bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buus gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob jumpa'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Eliiyas.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' tɨtda:―Cha'pim ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' jix koi jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' na ba' gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki gu Damasko; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria.
Jano' ba' gu Jeuu gu mar gu Nimsi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Eliseeo gu mar gu Sapat gu Abelmeula na ba' ka't jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan pai' tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu asael gu Jeuu; gio ba' gu Jeuu gu Eliseeo.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel kɨɨv jix bhai'x; gio ba' bɨx kɨkbok cham gu Baal gu chin bɨx cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo gu mar gu Sapat gu ñi'ook bɨɨx vupui bhaan; gio ba' ka't maa'n; mi' dhɨr bhɨi gu Eliiyas vupui bhaan jix duñia' bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax suudai' u'va jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eliiyas; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu taat gu naan tu'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ gu vaakax bɨɨx gu vaakax gu chuukug jix maa gu ja'tkam; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix búup ka't bhaan gu Eliiyas.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Ben-adad gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria jum daa'ñ bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gook gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx kavaayo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jix dhaas jix duñia' gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Ben-adad; gio ba' jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' bɨx no'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gui'p; gio ba' jix aa' gu Ben-adad; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' a'ga; jano' ba' jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh dhi' gu kavɨk tu' tu duukam kutun kavɨk gu vaak tu duukam; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨɨx gu noobh bɨx gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jup tɨɨt bɨx daraa gu oidha'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook cham bhai'; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai; jano' ba' tu' cham.
Jano' ba' bɨx daraa bɨx gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ben-adad; gio ba' ja'xñi gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr bɨx tu duukam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gu' dhi' cham bhaan; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu Ben-adad gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨip a'ga; gio ba' xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios oo' gu Samaria cham bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' ja'xñi cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p tu'.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p jix kai dhi' gu ñi'ook kua' i'i bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' vaak zel tu duukam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas bhaan kiicham.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr buupui dhi' jix gɨ' tu' kapbhai' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ na ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Akâb; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ chɨkka jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu novɨ chiñia' oidha' gɨ'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Akâb; mi' dhɨr chɨkka kua'da' jix aa'; jano' ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' oidha' gɨ' jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gook; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu kɨɨv jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' moor tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh; gio ba' ka't gu Ben-adad i'i gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak zel gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gook gu gɨ'kora' tɨbiap u'ua'tɨdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' oidha' gɨ' moor dharka'; gio ba' ka't gu Ben-adad jix maa aa'ñdham bham; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu Samaria.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ ko'iix; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' ko'iix.
Jano' ba' moor kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' oidha' gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' naaka'n maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; gio ba' jiboi'ññor gu Siros gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria gu Ben-adad gu ñi'ook kavaayo bɨɨx gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu' naaka'n gu ja'tkam kavaayo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Siros bɨɨx jix gɨ'.
Ba' jix aa' jimɨɨk gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; na gu' oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria tu' bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu kakkavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gu' tu' bɨɨx tu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu vupui; gio ba' jix buusñi gu gɨ'kora' maa'n gu ñi'ook jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ja'p ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham kavaayo; gio ba' bɨɨx yooxi' tu' cham; mi' dhɨr jix maa naak tu' jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga' gu Ben-adad gu Siros suudai' u'va gu Apek bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhaagɨk jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' yooxi' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan na ja'p gook gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Siros gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' jimɨɨk jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bham; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Siros jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu kakkavɨk cham gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu' kapbhai' bɨx dhi' jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ na ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh chooto'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' vupui bhaan kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix maa; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Siros gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiboi'ññor gu Apek kiicham; gio ba' vaak jodai bhaan gu ñi'ook kɨɨv jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gio gu Ben-adad suudai' u'va kiicham gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu duukam gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jano' gu ñi'ook ɨɨbhidham gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' u'ua'tɨda' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ɨɨbhidham tɨɨtɨs gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gui'p; gio ba' tu duukam gu Ben-adad tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu tai gu i'ii'ñ; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook xibhɨk.

Jano' ba' dhi' jix bhɨɨ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ jootom jix bhɨɨ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu chin gui'p; gio ba' xibhɨk gu Ben-adad jix aa'; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' gu Ben-adad jano' ba' gu Akâb jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Ben-adad; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh gu taat jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; mi' dhɨr gu vupui gu Damasko na ba' tu' na ja'p gu taat jix duu gu Samaria; jano' ba' tu' jix aa' gu Akâb tu' jix duu bɨɨx dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan; gio ba' jix duu bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam duiñchu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano'; gu' gu chio'ñ cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook maavɨt; mi' dhɨr na ja'p jix ai'chdhix maavɨt tu' naaka'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu chio'ñ; gio ba' jano'; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix maa koi'm tu' jix duu.
Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix duñia' bhaan gu vupui.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jix maa jiiñak gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu duukam jix buus tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr maa'n gu chio'ñ bham; jano' ba' gu Guarda dhi' gu chio'ñ tu' gu oidha' ka't gɨ' maa'nkar jodai jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tu duukam ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n; gio ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix aa'; mi' dhɨr ka't; jano' ba' tu'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jootom jix duñia' bhaan gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu chio'ñ gu oidha' ka't gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't gu vaak jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ja'tkam ka't gu Nabot gu Jesreel ga'ra' gu Jesreel oidha' u'va ju'ñdharan gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Samaria.
Ba' jix aa' gu Akâb gu Nabot bham; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' u'va na ba' u'uu pai' na gu' mia'n ju'ñdharan gu vaak tu' oidha' u'va tutkɨ dhi'; mi' dhɨr tu' tutkɨ tu' namkidha' tuumiñ.
Jano' ba' gu Nabot jix aa' gu Akâb; gio ba' cham jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa tu' gu maa'nkar tattat.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Akâb gu vaak jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Nabot gu Jesreel ka't tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' cham tu' gu maa'nkar tattat; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu vupui cham jix jugi gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu u'vɨ gu Jesabel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham jugi gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; na gu' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Nabot gu Jesreel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' u'va tuumiñ tu' oidha' u'va; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' cham tu' pai' u'va.
Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ gu Jesabel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jano' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel gu Lebaantate jugi gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr tu' oidha' u'va gu Nabot gu Jesreel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ua'na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Akâb bɨɨx bhañ daraa gu ñi'ook kiicham bɨɨx gu Nabot.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'na am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu Proklamad gu Nabot gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu chichio'ñ vupui bhaan bhaan; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix buusñi.
Jano' ba' kiicham daraa gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham jix duu na ja'p gu Jesabel jix aa'ñdhix jurtu'nka' ua'nak ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nabot gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs jano' ba' gook gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhadhaa vupui bhaan; gio ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu Belial bhaan gu Nabot vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam bham; mi' dhɨr gu Nabot tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'; jano' ba' mai' kiicham bɨɨx gu jodai jix koi.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr mɨjɨ a'ga gu Jesabel; gio ba' gu Nabot tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Jesabel jix kai gu Nabot ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi gu Akâb; gio ba' bamii' bia'ka' oidha' u'va gu Nabot gu Jesreel cham tu' tuumiñ; na gu' gu Nabot cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix koi.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Akâb gu Nabot ka't jix koi jix búup na ba' jix dhaav oidha' u'va gu Nabot gu Jesreel na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita bham.
Jano' ba' bamii' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Samaria; gio ba' oidha' u'va gu Nabot tu' jix duñia' na ba' gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' ñiokda' bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio ñiokda' bham; jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' pai' gu ñi'ook gagai' gu ɨ'ɨr gu Nabot gagai' gu ñi'ook gio gu ɨ'ɨr.
Ba' jix aa' gu Akâb gu Eliiyas; gio ba' gaagam bhaamki'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'; na gu' tu' jix duñia' cham bhai' bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham bhai' bhaan tu' gu Akâb bɨx jix bhai'x gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na ja'p gu vaak gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat na ja'p gu vaak gu Baasa gu mar gu Aiia; gio ba' bɨɨx daak bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Jesabel gio tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gagai' jugi gu Jesabel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jesreel.
Na gu Akâb ua'tulhi'ñ jix koi kiicham gagai' jugi; gio ba' ua'tulhi'ñ jix koi yooxi' jugi jix duñia' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' tu'r gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na ja'p gu Akâb duñia' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Jesabel gu u'vɨ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duiñxim jurtu'nka' bɨx jix duu gu Amorreos u'u kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu Akâb jix kai dhi' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix dhaas bhaan gu chuukug jix koox jix jiim jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita bham.

Na gu' cham buupui na ja'p gu Akâb tu' jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' na gu' tu' jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu mar cham bhai' bhaan gu vaak.
Jano' ba' vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Siros tu' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' ka't vaik oi'ñga' gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix dhaav gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu duukam; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ramot gu Galaad no'ch jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josapat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Ramot gu Galaad gu Josapat jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr na ja'p tu'; jano' ba' na ja'p gu ja'tkam; gio ba' na ja'p kavaayo.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jum daa'ñ na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' tu jiim bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Ramot gu Galaad gui'p; mi' dhɨr jix duñia'; na gu' gu Jawatan kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josapat; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix aa' gu Josapat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Mikêas gu mar gu Imla; na gu' gu' tu' na gu' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' xoi'kam gu ñi'ook cham bhai'; jano' ba' gu Josapat jix aa'; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jup tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' jootom gu Mikêas gu mar gu Imla.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n jajannulhi'ñ ɨrban ju'ñdharan ba'k ki'ñgob gu Samaria; gio ba' bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' vupui bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sedekîas gu mar gu Kânaana ka't gu ñi'ook a'aa' jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx suulhgia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Siros bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Ramot gu Galaad ka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu Jawatan Dios maa'n gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' mattuda' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt gu Mikêas bham; gio ba' gu Miren gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu chin jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr ka't jano' gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' jix duñia' xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu Mikêas jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Mikêas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Ramot gu Galaad jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' ka' gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mui'kim cham gu ñi'ook tu'r gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' tu' bɨx gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk na ja'p kakneer cham namki' bipia'dam; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam cham namki' gu Jawatan; gio ba' maa'n gu vaak bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat; gio ba' cham tu' ka't tu' tu ñi'ook gu Ninguna gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios daakat atooxkor bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr ka't ju'ñdharan kɨɨ'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Akâb na ba' jix duñia' gu Ramot gu Galaad maa'n chɨtda; mi' dhɨr chɨtda.
Ba' jix aa' jix buus gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Yo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chin bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' bɨɨx; gio ba' jix buus tu jiim.

Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chin bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook tu'.

Jano' ba' jimɨɨk jano' ba' gu Sedekîas gu mar gu Kânaana naaka'n gu Mikêas gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duukat ka't tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Mikêas jix aa'; na pai' dhuuk gu Miren tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Mikêas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amoon gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' kiicham gu Joas gu mar gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuupa' bɨɨx gu takarui' bɨɨx gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm tu' jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mikêas; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Ramot gu Galaad.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k; mi' dhɨr tu' jajannulhi'ñ; jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel chɨbiapui.
Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' cham tu' bɨɨx jix gɨ' tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josapat gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tɨɨtɨs na ba' bɨɨx; gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Josapat jix maa jiiñak.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook naaka'n gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook yooxi' dhi'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora' juruuñ vupui bhaan gu Siros gu xumai jix koi; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr baaso.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tas jix buus gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' bham; gio ba' maa'n kiicham gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samaria; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Samaria; gio ba' jix duñia' gio gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gagai' gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Akâb bɨx tu'x gu vaak gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx jɨ'dɨlh pai'x cham ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Akâb bɨɨx tattat jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Okôsiias gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Josapat gu mar gu Asa kua'da' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Judaa maakobh oi'ñga' gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Josapat gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Asuba mar u'vɨ gu Silai.
Jano' ba' jix jiim bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu Asa gu taat cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix bɨɨx duu; na gu ja'tkam gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josapat bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josapat cham ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu oidha' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu taat gu Asa.
Jano' ba' cham ka't jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Edom; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't pai' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Josapat gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tarsis tu' gu Opir jix uam jodai; na gu' gu' cham jix bɨɨx duu na gu' gu Esion-geber.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Okôsiias gu mar gu Akâb gu Josapat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam bɨɨx; gu' gu Josapat cham.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Josapat bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' bɨɨx tattat kiicham gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' pai' jix gɨ'kora' gu Joram gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Okôsiias gu mar gu Akâb kua'da' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Israeel gu Samaria oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' gook bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu taat gu bhóogɨt gu naan gu bhóogɨt gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat jix duñia' gu Israeel; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baal daak gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jurtu'nka' tu'x gu taat ka't gu ñi'ook.
